label: Contingent aggregate fact, other-fact…: The admitted aggregate is itself a contingent fact and…
term: contingent aggregate fact, other-fact inclusion and necessary explanation in presentation #7
definition: The admitted aggregate is itself a contingent fact and includes all OTHER contingent facts. Explanation is unelaborated; step4 excludes it from contingent facts and step5 calls it necessary. Facts/explanations are not identified with concrete beings. Inclusion supplies no specified primitive self-conjunct, mereological composition, truth-distribution or explanation-distribution law.
note: Minimal editorial glossary for p14. Exact fact admission, actual truth/factivity, necessary-versus-contingent classification, inclusion/reflexivity and real explanatory interpretation remain OPEN. Existing PSRStrength/BCCF predicates may be compared only with their explicit guards; necessitation, concrete bearers, universal common causes and unread Pruss content are not silently added.
